sources.title: ArjunM25MAC003/HInglish-Intent-Classifier - GitHub
sources.snippet: A Colab-ready multi-task NLP project for classifying Indian e-commerce user queries written in Hinglish (Hindi + English code-mixed text). The solution leverages a shared MuRIL encoder and multiple task-specific heads to predict intent, product category, price range, color, and language mix.

sources.title: Serj/intent-classifier · Hugging Face
sources.snippet: Sometimes intent classification is referred to as topic classification. By fine tuning a T5 model with prompts containing sythetic data that resembles customer's requests this model is able to classify intents in a dynamic way by adding all of the categories to the prompt

sources.title: Building Robust Intent Classifiers with Generative AI
sources.snippet: LLM-based intent classifiers route zero-shot, with reasoning and no per-intent training data. How to build one robust enough for production multi-agent systems.
